module_summary: main_info_screens.c holds the classic uLE About/Build info/Debug info/ShowFont screens, which the dashboard has re-implemented in dash_info.c. main_modules.c and main_startup.c are the boot sequence helpers: boot path normalisation and boot-device detection, boot device/network stack bring-up, ROMVER region/TV-mode detection, IPCONFIG.DAT and SYSTEM.CNF parsing. main_title.c keeps the RTC/software clock and CDVD temperature state used by the classic title bar and the dashboard, plus timestamp local-time conversion and clock/date formatting helpers. makeicon.c generates a memory-card icon.icn with text rendered from the uLE font, and the icon.sys. mc_card_export.c copies, converts (no-ECC .mcd to PCSX2 528-byte/page .ps2 and back) and verifies memory-card images; mc_card_view.h is the API of the read-only card image parser used by the card tool and the card writer.

reusable_helpers.what: builds a 528-byte PCSX2 page (512 data + 12 ECC + 4 zero) from a 512-byte page

reusable_helpers.name: write_exact_at
reusable_helpers.what: static: open (create/truncate on first chunk), seek and write exactly N bytes, then close

findings.title: Classic info screens in main_info_screens.c are superseded by dash_info.c and reachable only through alias edge cases
findings.problem: Show_About_uLE, Show_build_info, ShowDebugInfo and ShowFont (all of main_info_screens.c) have native replacements dashShowAbout/dashShowBuildInfo/dashShowSystemInfo/dashShowFontViewer, and dashRunMisc matches the four MISC paths before anything reaches ExecuteMainAction. The classic branches at main_actions.c:790-801 are left for paths dashRunMisc does not match exactly: the legacy 'About uLE' alias accepted by isMiscAboutWlePath, or a MISC path typed by hand as the IGR-after path (main.c:240). The file also carries a 27-line commented-out gsKit test block (312-338) and a leftover 'show font twice' test pass (382-385).
findings.fix: Make dashRunMisc (or the four ExecuteMainAction branches) call the dash_info.c screens, accepting the legacy About alias there too. Then delete src/main_info_screens.c, include/main_info_screens.h, its ps2.yaml entry, the four classic branches and isMiscAboutWlePath, and update the stubs in tests/test_launch_driver_messages.py:206-210.
findings.benefit: ~400 source lines removed. ELF: the four functions are 2108+820+1416+800 = 5144 B of .text (MEASURED, evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv), plus their strings (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep Show_About_uLE|Show_build_info|ShowDebugInfo|ShowFont over repo: only main_actions.c:791-800 call them (plus docs and test stubs). dash_main.c:478-493 dashRunMisc intercepts Misc_About_uLE/Show_Build_Info/Debug_Info/ShowFont; runMiscCommand (dash_main.c:378-449) is the only dash path to ExecuteMainAction for MISC paths and runs after that check; dashLaunchApp is used for paths with ':' (dash_main.c:787-789). The classic getFilePath browser that lists MISC entries (filer.c:2401-2444) is reached with cnfmode FALSE only from main_actions.c:738,774,886; 738/774 are behind Misc_FileBrowser/TextEditor which dashRunMisc intercepts (dash_main.c:466-473); ExecuteBrowserFrom (main_actions.c:877) has no caller. That no other route exists is INFERRED. ps2.yaml:494 compiles the file.

findings.title: tex_drawChar builds each glyph through a 16x32 temp image with run detection; it compiles to 10.5 KB
findings.problem: tex_drawChar zeroes a 16x32 u16 temp array, finds vertical runs of set font bits, sets every other pixel, ORs the gaps in by rows then by columns, and copies the whole block out. The result is a 2x2 pixel block for every set font bit. The measured function size is 10548 bytes (loops unrolled). The colour parameter is never used (always 0xFFFF), and tex_printXY's return value is never read ('not needed for anything').
findings.fix: Replace the body with a double loop over the 8x16 font bits that writes a 2x2 block of 0xFFFF straight into tex_buffer for each set bit; the buffer is already zeroed in make_icon. Drop the unused colour parameter and make tex_drawChar/tex_printXY static and void.
findings.benefit: ~40 lines removed; tex_drawChar is 10548 B of .text (MEASURED, sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv); a direct 2x2 write is well under 1 KB, so about 9-10 KB of ELF saved (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read makeicon.c:110-226: temp_image[2i][2j] set per set bit (133,140), row OR (146-148) and column OR (151-153) give 2x2 blocks; tex_buffer is memset 0 at 338 and characters step by 16 px / 32 rows (169, 182-184), so writing only set pixels is equivalent except for '\v'/'\t' overlaps, which folder names do not contain (callers filer_browser.c:1497, 2455). colour is only passed along at 199/212/220. Size from evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv: '10548 FUNC GLOBAL .text tex_drawChar'. The size of the rewrite is INFERRED.

findings.title: makeicon: tex_compresRLE copies its result into a second malloc, and the texture buffer is never freed (leak per icon)
findings.problem: tex_compresRLE mallocs a 32 KB output buffer, then mallocs a second buffer of the compressed size, copies into it and frees the first. make_icon returns on every path (success 364, errors 344/368) without freeing tex_buffer, so each folder icon created through filerCreateFolderIcon (filer_browser.c:2455) leaks the compressed texture; the next call overwrites the pointer. None of the three mallocs is checked (memset/write on NULL at 338/246).
findings.fix: In tex_compresRLE free the old tex_buffer and keep new_tex as tex_buffer (no second malloc or memcpy). Free tex_buffer (and set it to NULL) before every return in make_icon, and return -1 if a malloc fails.
findings.justification: The leak is real on every icon creation, and the NULL checks guard the only allocations in this path; the change is a few lines and removes one malloc and a copy.
findings.benefit: Fixes a leak of the RLE texture (a few KB, INFERRED from 16384 u16 pixels of mostly black runs) per icon written; removes one transient malloc and memcpy per icon.
findings.evidence: Read makeicon.c:236-256 and 337-368: tex_buffer assigned at 252 and 337, freed only at 251 inside tex_compresRLE; no free in make_icon. Grep tex_buffer: only makeicon.c. Callers of make_icon: filer_browser.c:1497 and 2455 (filerCreateFolderIcon).

findings.title: mc_card_export.c has five near-identical copy-then-verify loops (backup, active-MMCE backup, PCSX2 export x2, PCSX2 import)
findings.problem: Each function has the same argument checks, a chunked write pass, a chunked read-back verify pass with memcmp, progress calls and remove-on-failure tail. They differ only in three points: the source is read through a kept-open fd (ActiveMmce variants) or reopened per chunk; the block transform (none, convert_block, strip_pcsx2_block); and whether the destination is created exclusively (only_new). The ActiveMmce pair duplicates the path pair line for line except for read_exact_fd vs read_exact_at.
findings.fix: Fold them into one static engine taking (keep_source_open, transform, only_new). Keep the nine public names as one-line wrappers so the callers and tests do not change.
findings.benefit: ~150 lines removed (288 lines across the five bodies to ~110 plus wrappers, INFERRED). Their code is 732+736+912+820+1032 = 4232 B (MEASURED, sizes tsv); about 2 KB saved after merging (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read all five bodies. Same chunk expression at 261/274, 316/329, 396/414, 459/475, 569/586; same remove tail at 289-291, 346-349, 434-436, 494-496, 605-608. Callers: dash_browser.c:1588,1659,1718,1784-1785,1882,1971-1972,2184-2185,2271-2272; dash_card_tool.c:305,1197; cloud_google.c:1061-1062; mmce_backup.c:594-596. Many tests grep for the public call strings (e.g. tests/test_mmce_exclusive_new_files.py:39-41), so the public names must stay. Function sizes from evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv. Risk High: memory-card image backup/restore.

findings.title: mc_card_export.c duplicates its own I/O and header helpers (write_exact_at/_new, read_exact_at/read_exact_fd, source_info_fd/pcsx2_source_info)
findings.problem: write_exact_at_new (137-161) is write_exact_at (109-130) with different open flags and an 'owned' flag, re-pasted with 4-space indents. read_exact_at (87-107) is open + the loop of read_exact_fd (224-237) + close. pcsx2_source_info (500-535) repeats source_info_fd's magic check, superblock field reads and geometry check (173-203); only the bytes-per-page used for the expected size differs (528 vs 512).
findings.fix: Give write_exact_at the flags/owned parameters and delete write_exact_at_new; implement read_exact_at as open + read_exact_fd + close; make one header parser that takes the page stride and returns raw and encoded sizes.
findings.benefit: ~50 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges); a few hundred bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read both copies of each pair. Loops at 121-128 and 152-159 are identical; 98-105 and 230-235 identical apart from closing; 182-199 vs 513-530 share magic, read_le16(header+40/42), read_le32(header+48) and the same checks. All helpers are static and used only in this file (Grep over src).

findings.title: main_title.c: menuTitleFormat and menuTitleGetClockText have no caller; clock prototypes are declared twice
findings.problem: menuTitleFormat and menuTitleGetClockText are referenced only by their definitions and prototypes; the comment at 717-720 describes GetClockText, not the function below it. dash_internal.h:1161-1167 redeclares menuTitleGetTemperatureRaw, menuTitleFormatClockTime and menuTitleFormatClockDate, which main_title.h already declares, and is the only home of menuTitleGetClockFields.
findings.fix: Delete menuTitleFormat, menuTitleGetClockText, their prototypes and the stale comment. Move the menuTitleGetClockFields prototype into main_title.h, delete the dash_internal.h block, and include main_title.h in dash_ui.c and dash_bg_ps2.c.
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed; no ELF change: both functions are already discarded by --gc-sections (660 B and 220 B, MEASURED in evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-all.tsv).
findings.evidence: Grep -w menuTitleFormat and menuTitleGetClockText over the whole repo (src include tests scripts docs): only main_title.c:680/746, main_title.h:6, dash_internal.h:1163 and the comment at main_title.c:718. gc-discarded-all.tsv lists .text.menuTitleFormat 660 and .text.menuTitleGetClockText 220. Users of the dash_internal.h prototypes: dash_ui.c:414,431,454,461 and dash_bg_ps2.c:477.

findings.title: main_title.c token template MENU_TITLE_FORMAT is a fixed string, so menuTitleUses* and the care_time/care_date plumbing are always true
findings.problem: MENU_TITLE_FORMAT is the compile-time constant "$TIME  $DATE  $TEMP", so hasToken, menuTitleUsesTime/Date/Clock/Temp/DynamicTokens always return 1. Every branch on them in menuTitleUpdateAsync, menuTitleFormatClock and menuTitleFormatTemperature is constant, and updateClock/refreshClockText/seedClockFromPs2 always get care_time = care_date = 1. appendChar/appendText only rebuild what one snprintf does.
findings.fix: Delete MENU_TITLE_FORMAT, hasToken and the five menuTitleUses* helpers and their branches; drop the care_time/care_date parameters (refreshClockText returns whether either string changed); write menuTitleFormatClock and menuTitleFormatTemperature as single snprintf calls and delete appendChar/appendText (after finding 6 removes menuTitleFormat). Adjust tests/test_software_clock.py:75, which calls updateClock(tick, force, 1, 1).
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges); the helpers are static and probably folded by -O2, so the ELF effect is small (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep MENU_TITLE_FORMAT: main_title.c:11,58,63,73,693 only. menuTitleUses* used only inside main_title.c (598-606, 641-648, 673, 690-691). updateClock call sites: 482, 497, 502, 516 (all 1,1) and 605 (uses_time/uses_date, always 1). tests/test_software_clock.py:75 and tests/test_temperature.py:43,78 extract functions from this file.

findings.title: buildBootBlockPath is 53 lines of manual bounded concatenation equivalent to one snprintf
findings.problem: buildBootBlockPath appends prefix, partition, an optional '/' and path_part with four copies of the same room/chunk/memcpy step and NULL defaults. Its only caller (589) passes non-NULL arguments into a MAX_PATH buffer; snprintf with "%s%s%s%s" and the conditional slash gives the same truncating result.
findings.fix: Replace the call with snprintf(LaunchElfDir, sizeof(LaunchElfDir), "%s%s%s%s", hdd_prefix, temp, path_part[1] == '/' ? "" : "/", path_part + 1) and delete the function and its forward declaration.
findings.benefit: ~55 lines removed; buildBootBlockPath is 300 B of .text (MEASURED, sizes tsv), replaced by one snprintf call (~40 B, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep buildBootBlockPath over repo: main_startup.c:28 (declaration), 465 (definition), 589 (only call). tests/test_bgm_sidecar.py:223-237 compiles prepareBootDeviceAndPath and covers the hdd0: case at 237, so the change is host-testable. Size line '300 FUNC LOCAL .text buildBootBlockPath' in evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes/wLaunchELF-unstripped-all-symbols-by-size.tsv.

findings.title: main_startup.c small redundancies: one-entry ROMVER path loop, second ROMVER prefix parser, redundant #if, unused counter
findings.problem: uLE_InitializeRegion loops over a one-element romver_paths array and strncpy's the literal into path_buf before opening it. getRomverPrefixNumber re-parses the first four ROMVER digits as decimal, although initializeBootExecPath already parses them as hex into ROMVersion; for digit-only prefixes 'decimal >= 220' equals 'ROMVersion >= 0x220'. The hide flag is set in two places (292 and 755). The outer #if defined(ETH) || defined(UDPFS) at 597/606 only wraps two inner #ifdefs. readSystemCnf counts var_cnt and scanSystemCnf returns a value, and neither is read.
findings.fix: Open "rom0:ROMVER" directly; compute hide_hdd_ata_devices only in shouldHideHddAtaDevices from strtoul(prefix, NULL, 16) >= 0x220 and delete getRomverPrefixNumber and line 292; drop the outer #if; drop var_cnt and make scanSystemCnf void.
findings.benefit: ~35 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges); negligible ELF change.
findings.evidence: Read main_startup.c fully. romver_paths has one entry (217-219). getRomverPrefixNumber called at 292 and 754 only (Grep). shouldHideHddAtaDevices can run before initializeBootExecPath (bringUpBootDeviceStack at main_boot.c:51 precedes initializeBootDisplayDefaults at :52), so the lazy path must stay. var_cnt is written only at 180; the scanSystemCnf return is ignored at 181.

findings.title: main_modules.c: unused boot_device parameter, dead WaitTime stores, one-line font wrapper, stale comments
findings.problem: initializeRuntimeInputModules ignores boot_device ((void)boot_device at 25). It sets WaitTime at 27 and 58, but every reader (editor_file.c:58,181,207,249,318) sets WaitTime itself right before reading it. loadConfiguredBootFont (main_startup.c:714) only calls loadFont(setting->font_file) and has one caller (main_modules.c:64). The comments at 35 ('early setupPad above') and 47 ('main menu') describe code that is gone.
findings.fix: Drop the parameter (and the argument at main.c:279), delete both WaitTime stores, call loadFont(setting->font_file) directly and delete loadConfiguredBootFont and its prototype, and delete the two stale comments.
findings.evidence: Grep -w WaitTime: main.c:35 (definition), launchelf.h:651, main_modules.c:27,58, editor_file.c:58-59,181-182,207-208,249-250,318-319 (each read is preceded by its own store). Grep initializeRuntimeInputModules: main.c:279 only. Grep loadConfiguredBootFont: main_startup.h:26, main_startup.c:714, main_modules.c:64. No test references either function.

findings.title: McView fields cardtype, cardflags and version are written but never read
findings.problem: mcViewOpen copies the superblock version string and the cardtype/cardflags bytes into McView, but no EE source or host test reads them. has_ecc (mc_card_view.h:40) is read only by the host test printout tests/mc_card_view_host.c:37.
findings.fix: Delete the three fields and the four assignments.
findings.benefit: ~7 lines removed and 15 bytes per McView (INFERRED: char[13] + 2 x u8).
findings.evidence: Grep -w cardtype|cardflags|has_ecc over the repo: EE hits only mc_card_view.h:40-42 and mc_card_view.c:216,246,247 (all other hits are iop/vmcman's own structs); tests/mc_card_view_host.c:37 prints has_ecc. Grep '\.version\b|->version' over src/tests outside iop: no read of McView.version (other hits are unrelated structs).
